purpose: Prevent an eta-resolved current release2-end Q_s state or any eta-wise implied matching-time diagnostic from being silently scalarized into one current l=-h Cartesian bridge length or promoted to unified Kokuno velocity delivery.

bindings.independent_audit_role: external sibling diagnostic only; not ingested as candidate truth

user_requirement: Deliver an explicit callable and save-loadable velocity(x,y,z,t)->[u,v,w] without treating PDE validation as a prerequisite for callability.
Keep velocity delivery, visual correspondence, PDE validation, paper exactness, and OpenAI-field identification as independent states.
public_source_fact: After the published release schedule, the corrected reconstruction uses an l=-h matching stage and, for the source-ideal scalar schedule, Q_s(y)=Q_in*exp(-(1-h)y) until Q_p is reached.
The terminal target Q_p and the l=-h matching stage are construction ingredients; their source use does not by itself identify the current carried candidate's eta-resolved release2 endpoint.
autonomous_design: PR #1225 materializes the current carried release2-end Q_s as a function of eta using the general radial identity and repository numerical realization.
This CR002 contract treats eta-wise implied T(eta)=log(Q_s(eta)/Q_p)/(1-h) as a representation diagnostic only unless a legal bridge construction is separately materialized.
Finite eta sampling, scalar summaries, or a convenient representative eta do not establish an eta-independent current bridge length.
pending_unknown: Whether the exact current Q_s release2 endpoint is eta-independent on the full applicable eta interval.

Whether one scalar current l=-h matching length exists for this carried state under the intended construction, or whether an eta-dependent bridge geometry requires a new explicitly governed candidate design.

Current Cartesian matching bridge and terminal multiplier composition, exterior/global leading completion, matched pressure, restricted forcing, complete NS residual, visual correspondence, PDE validation, paper exactness, and OpenAI-field identity.

promotion_prerequisites: Establish the full-interval eta structure of the exact current release2-end Q_s: either prove/derive eta-independence on the applicable interval or explicitly retain its eta dependence with a bounded, declared representation.

If a single scalar bridge is claimed, derive that scalar from the exact current identity and prove that the same l=-h evolution reaches Q_p for the full applicable eta state; finite probe agreement or scalar summaries are insufficient.

If an eta-dependent matching boundary is used instead, define it as an explicit autonomous/source-supported construction with smooth coordinate/Cartesian semantics, axis regularity, domain coverage, and a new semantic identity; do not silently reinterpret the source scalar stage.
Compose the chosen bridge and terminal multiplier into the actual Cartesian velocity provider and create a new save-load identity.
Replay finite-value, axis, seam, save-load, and claimed project-domain coverage checks on that exact Cartesian identity; keep visual/PDE/paper/OpenAI gates separate.

mechanics_witness.claim: A positive eta-resolved endpoint can require different pointwise matching times; replacing those by one scalar leaves pointwise terminal mismatch away from the representative eta. This is logic only, not Kokuno/OpenAI numerical evidence.
